purpose: Determine whether the public CooperScene implementation exposes an executable, trace-grounded payload-completion path and whether its public payload accounting is sufficient for a bounded Idea.

sources.scope: All 12 directed throughput channels in official mcap_preview/9.mcap.

sources.title: CellReplay: Towards accurate record-and-replay for cellular networks
sources.role: Primary evidence that replaying a trace collected under one workload for a different workload can be biased unless workload sensitivity is validated.

radioExperiment.description: The paper source says model data were segmented into 2100-byte chunks and sent sequentially over the C-V2X radio.

paperMeasurementContract.claimBoundary: The paper reports physical transmission times in Table 2 and separately describes synchronized C-V2X measurements. Those physical measurements are not equivalent to the current public scalar-throughput simulator.
paperMeasurementContract.derivedThroughputCaveat: sharingSizeMB*8/(latencyMs/1000) is only an aggregate arithmetic reconstruction. It does not identify scheduling, parallelism, per-link allocation, packet loss, or the exact paper implementation.

table2Runner: tools/run_table2.sh defaults every agent setting to the same 1.6 Mbps scalar.
The script computes one per-cooperator share_size_mb and passes the same scalar throughput to every collaborator in a setting.
The script tells users to edit or override throughput values but does not ship the per-take or per-link values required to reconstruct the paper's physical transmission experiment.
datasetDelayPath: CoopDataset converts share_size_mb to megabits, divides it by one scalar cv2x_throughput, converts the result to milliseconds, and floors it to 100 ms frame steps.
_build_valid_coops applies the same delay calculation independently to every collaborator; no directed MCAP channel is loaded.
_lookup_delayed clamps any delay beyond the available history to the first indexed frame instead of exposing a censored or unavailable message state.
If a delayed lookup returns None, the current synchronized collaborator frame remains in use.
modelDelayPath: CooperativeDetector defaults prior_encoding=[time_delay, velocity, infra] to zeros.
The audited dataset path does not thread the computed delay or age into prior_encoding.
A model can therefore receive a stale historical collaborator point cloud while its explicit time-delay input remains zero.

analyticPayloadCalculator.method: tools/calc_sharing.py analytically multiplies compressed BEV feature dimensions by four bytes per fp32 value.
analyticPayloadCalculator.interpretation: The shipped calculator is useful as a deterministic static baseline, but its 0.67-1.08 ratios against the four paper-listed payloads show that it cannot substitute for runtime tensor or serialized-byte instrumentation.

interpretation: A single shared 1.6 Mbps scalar is outside the observed mean range of all 12 audited take-9 preview links.
The 12 links are neither exchangeable nor independent in this sample; direction, sender identity, and synchronous structure are candidate explanatory variables.
These statistics are descriptive evidence from one preview take and cannot be generalized to the release before all-take schema and trace audits pass.

workloadTransferGuardrail.collectionWorkload: The paper states that each agent ran one Iperf2 UDP client at 5 Mbps and three servers, with 100 ms reports.
workloadTransferGuardrail.targetWorkloads: The candidate model payloads, packetization, concurrency, and deadlines differ from the collection workload.
workloadTransferGuardrail.risk: A recorded application-layer throughput series may not be invariant to a new payload or sender schedule; direct integration can therefore be a benchmark abstraction without being a faithful live-radio counterfactual.
requiredCalibration: Before any real-network claim, compare replayed completion-time distributions against the paper's physical-radio Table-2 transmission measurements at their published payload sizes and agent settings.
Predeclare an error tolerance and leave-one-payload-out calibration test; do not tune the replay on the same payload used for validation.
If the public artifacts cannot map Table-2 measurements to takes or reproduce the packetization schedule, report the comparison as a coarse consistency check rather than validation.
If replay error exceeds tolerance, restrict all conclusions to sensitivity of the released benchmark abstraction and do not call them C-V2X deployment results.
workloadTransferGuardrail.forbiddenShortcut: Do not infer workload-independent service capacity from one Iperf trace merely because the throughput field has an Mbps interpretation.

minimumExecutableInstrumentation: Hook the exact tensor immediately after each model's compression or selection step and record shape, dtype, numel, element size, sparsity representation, serialization format, metadata overhead, and final bytes per sender.
Create a strict sidecar keyed by take, ego receiver, sender, and aligned LiDAR timestamp; reject any missing, duplicate, nonmonotonic, or unverified frame mapping.
Integrate only observed Vector3.x throughput over observed intervals, under an explicit unit-scale sensitivity analysis, until the measured payload bit count completes.
Expose complete, incomplete, censored-before-take-start, and trace-missing as separate states; never clamp an unavailable message to the first frame.
Thread completion-derived age into prior_encoding and retain the exact historical frame identity chosen at the receiver deadline.
Freeze checkpoints and perception inputs before comparing constant 1.6 Mbps, static mean-link throughput, exact directed trace order, and preregistered surrogate traces.

researchOpportunity.problem: The released code can reproduce a scalar stale-frame abstraction but cannot presently reproduce a directed, trace-grounded payload-completion process or distinguish an unfinished transmission from an old available frame.
researchOpportunity.boundedQuestion: Do link direction, temporal ordering, cross-link dependence, runtime payload, and explicit censoring materially change the deployability verdict or method ordering relative to the shipped scalar-delay abstraction?
researchOpportunity.scientificValueIfPositive: Identifies which network structures and payload accounting choices are necessary for valid cooperative-perception conclusions and supplies an executable replay contract.
researchOpportunity.scientificValueIfNegative: Validates a cheaper scalar or marginal abstraction for the audited release and quantifies where it is sufficient.
notAClaim: This audit does not claim that the paper's reported Table-2 measurements are wrong.
This audit does not claim packet loss, jitter, or end-to-end latency can be replayed from the current public MCAP schema.
This audit does not claim a model ranking changes before the replay is implemented and run.
This audit does not infer a radio cause from correlations.

stopRules: Stop model-level replay if the official release cannot support a verified MCAP-time-to-perception-frame mapping.
Stop cross-take inference if the 14 full takes do not share an auditable directed-throughput schema.
Report only scheduling-level sensitivity if runtime payload bytes cannot be instrumented for the chosen official checkpoints.
Downgrade to a finite-release descriptive study if the available independent take count is inadequate for the preregistered uncertainty target.
